detectors.aggregation_policy: Per-token negative natural-log next-token probabilities; logits[:, :-1] predict IDs[:, 1:]; concatenate unique targets; 128-token feature windows, stride 64, partial tail retained
detectors.b2_feature_semantics: 10 inherited features + 6 frozen length-conditioned benign-reference features + 10 distributional surprisal features; no inference-time refit/scaler/imputation
detectors.calibrator_probability_warning: Probability-valued implementation; no guarantee of perfect calibration or shifted-distribution calibration

chunking_policy.tail_handling: full retained-prefix tail; next-token positions scored once; overlapping context discarded from repeated targets

detectors.insufficient_input_policy: Fewer than two content tokens: insufficient_input, no score or binary vote
detectors.native_score_definition: sigmoid(B2_features @ LR_coefficients + LR_intercept); class 1 ATTACK probability; uncalibrated
notes: reference_hash identifies the B2 feature-reference artifact, not LM weights; separate per-file LM hashes retained

R0 uses fold-local B2+LR raw OOF scores, not the final full-BASE_TRAIN model or calibrator.
detectors.truncation_policy: Keep first 4096 content tokens; tokenize without truncation or added special tokens; first token is unscored

detectors.aggregation_policy: One sequence softmax; no chunk aggregation
detectors.calibrator_probability_warning: Probability-valued implementation; no guarantee of perfect calibration or shifted-distribution calibration
detectors.native_binary_rule: raw_score >= 0.5; calibrator never changes native binary_vote
notes: 512 usable context; transformer config has 514 positional embeddings. Project limit remains 256.
Raw and calibrated values are probabilities by implementation; no claim of perfect calibration.
R0 ranking/points use raw OOF scores; not full-model calibrated inference.
detectors.special_token_policy: add_special_tokens=True; RoBERTa single-sequence boundary tokens included in 256-token budget; padding excluded from counts
detectors.truncation_policy: Right truncation at 256 tokens including special tokens; right padding to longest in batch

detectors.insufficient_input_policy: Zero content tokens: insufficient_input; null raw_score and binary_vote
detectors.native_binary_rule: OR over chunk logits.argmax == class 1; ties choose class 0
detectors.native_score_definition: max over chunks of temperature-1 softmax(logits)[:, 1]
notes: Model name is 22M; serialized architecture is DebertaV2ForSequenceClassification. Provider labels are generic; class meaning is supported by frozen provider evidence.

detectors.truncation_policy: No input truncation; preserve upstream tokenizer normalization, slice token IDs without decode/re-encode
